cells.gaps: The 1,100,600 refugees and asylum-seekers of April 2026 are registered with a number, but no source says identity documents were issued to them. No source since October 2023 says refugees or displaced people may use SIM cards, mobile money or digital ID.
cells.note: Stage 2: 1,100,600 refugees and asylum-seekers were registered with UNHCR by April 2026, and the government told them to register for an ID card in 2024. No source says documents were issued with a number, so question 2 is unmet.
